head: 76fd3befc0bcbc8d8f98b123f612a34f2e11ae94
claim: the built @byokit/herdr 0.16.4 settles a status watch Herdr refuses, settles a stopped subscription's readiness, and keeps the events a parked bootstrap holds bounded

target.version: @byokit/herdr 0.16.4 (built from commit 76fd3befc0bcbc8d8f98b123f612a34f2e11ae94, the release branch merged with the current main)

steps.start: The built @byokit/herdr 0.16.4 adopts the kit's own stand-in Herdr (a Unix socket server, no real Herdr, no account, no network) and starts with a tree of one workspace whose pane carries an agent.
steps: a status watch Herdr refuses: the pane closed, so Herdr answers the pane's status watch with a pane_not_found frame whose id is null, omitted, empty, the request's own id, or Herdr's own per-subscription probe id; the app calls kit.refresh().
a stopped subscription's readiness: the app opens a subscription and stops it before any acknowledgement arrives.
the events a parked bootstrap holds bounded: the app calls kit.refresh() while a status watch is never acknowledged and 800 pane.updated events keep arriving.
steps.result: Every refused status watch settles the refresh in 0-2 ms with the refusal logged; the stopped subscription's readiness settles false in 0 ms; the events a parked bootstrap holds stay bounded - the kit reports 'the bootstrap buffer hit its cap (513 events, 61853 bytes held)', the refresh settles in 479 ms and the tree is re-read from Herdr (1 tree read before, 3 after).

verdicts.seen: I read all nine capture lines. The five status-watch lines (id shape null, omitted, empty, request, probe) each log 'status subscription rejected: pane_not_found' and settle in 0–1 ms, which covers the refused-watch part. The stopped-subscription line reports 'settled in 0 ms: false', covering readiness. The parked-bootstrap lines show the buffer hit its cap at 513 events and 61853 bytes, the tree was re-read, the refresh settled in 479 ms, and the closing line says 'every case settled and stayed bounded'. Together these match the three parts of the outcome, and the exit code is 0.
